name: RegentFX Fast Boot
author: omp
description: Conditional boot-stall fix for RegentFX. Requires RegentFXFastBoot to load BEFORE RegentFX. The game's modding screen cannot reorder mods, so set the order with a load-order editor: Load Order Manager (Steam Workshop 3747605109) adds a Load Order button to the modding screen - move RegentFXFastBoot above RegentFX, Apply, restart. Keep exactly ONE RegentFXFastBoot install: a local copy plus a workshop copy adds a second row later in mod_list, and sorting keys priorities by id with last index winning, so that later row overrides the enabled one and forces late order every launch. When a launch cannot be accelerated (RegentFX loaded first), the mod shows a one-shot popup on the main menu with the steps above and a 'do not show again' button. It never writes your settings and never reorders your mods. In the correct order it skips RegentFX's synchronous scene preload (only when RegentFX's own PreloadEffects setting is on) and re-warms the same scene cache one path at a time through the engine's own asynchronous loading surface.
